notes: Base (non-suffixed) MX2-16x16-HDMI20: single internal PSU with standard IEC AC inlet, 3-pole Phoenix (Euroblock) RS-232, and RJ45 Ethernet — confirmed directly from Lightware's own MX2-HDMI20 series Quick Start Guide (covers this exact model) and User's Manual appendix (specifications, control-port, and rear-panel-drawing pages). This base model has no analog audio ports — those (5-pole Phoenix in/out) are exclusive to the "-Audio" suffixed variant, and dual redundant PowerCON power / D-SUB RS-232 / etherCON Ethernet are exclusive to the "-R" suffixed variant; do not conflate specs across variants. All 16 HDMI inputs and 16 HDMI outputs are 19-pole HDMI Type A, HDMI 2.0 (18 Gbps, up to 4096x2160@60Hz RGB 4:4:4, HDCP 2.2/1.4, DVI 1.0/HDMI 1.4 backward compatible). Rack height is 3U (measured enclosure height 132.6mm rack-ear-to-ear consistent with 3U); width 441mm (483mm with rack ears), depth 280.2mm. Weight not listed for the exact base non-R model in the manual (only -Audio, -R and -Audio-R weights given: 8540g listed for -R); base model weight likely similar but not separately confirmed. LAN speed grade (1G) is an inference — manufacturer specs did not state Ethernet port speed, only "RJ45 connector for LAN/Ethernet control"; USB port speed is unspecified and left ungraded. Front-panel USB connector type (USB-A vs USB-B/Micro) inferred as USB-A based on typical Lightware "USB Control" ports and diagram icon; not explicitly labeled with connector sub-type in text. Sources used: Lightware official product page (lightware.com), Lightware MX2-HDMI20 series User's Manual PDF (specifications/appendix and rear-panel drawings), and Lightware's own MX2-HDMI20 Quick Start Guide PDF (explicit rear-panel connector callouts distinguishing base vs -R vs -Audio variants).

ports.name: RS-232
ports.note: 3-pole Phoenix/Euroblock connector (non-redundant base model); the -R variant uses a 9-pole D-SUB instead

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: RJ45 for Ethernet/LAN control; the -R variant uses a Neutrik etherCON connector instead. Speed grade (1G) inferred, not explicitly stated by manufacturer

ports.name: USB CTRL
ports.note: Front-panel USB port for local control via Lightware Device Controller software; USB speed not specified by manufacturer, no grade set

ports.name: AC IN
ports.note: Standard IEC connector (single PSU), 100-240V AC 50/60Hz. The -R variant instead uses dual Neutrik powerCON inlets
